nom: VICHY Mineral 89 Daily Face Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.titre: Amazing moisturizer it just takes time to fully workAmazing moisturizer it just takes time to fully work
avis.texte: I was very skeptical at first but I needed to find something to moisturizer my skin during the winter months and to help with my skin tone and texture. The first month I noticed small little changes, not enough to be completely satisfied. I continued using the moisturizer month #2 and I noticed a change to the size of my pores on my cheeks beside my nose and the wrinkles and scars from years of cystic acne. My month 3 and on my third jar. I noticed longer have to wear makeup and the texture and look of my skin is beautiful. I also use the rice water brightening facial cleanser, mucin snail gel, and a brightening squalane oil serum before adding the moisturizer. These 4 products have been a game charger for sure but the moisturizer is the one benefitting my face the most. Definitely buy, just be patient.

By far this is my absolute favorite face moisturizer that not only hydrates my skin, but heals and helps repair it too. I noticed that my skin became more evenly colored and the dark spots went away. Sure this is a little pricey, but as long as you’re not putting on way too much on your face, then this goes a long way. I have to buy more every three weeks so by the fourth week I don’t run out. I simply refuse to run out of this. I am simply addicted to it.

avis.titre: Amazing skin boost — Vichy 89 is a game-changer!
avis.texte: I’ve been using Vichy 89 for a few weeks, and I’m loving the results! It gives my skin an instant boost of hydration and makes my complexion feel refreshed and plump. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling soft and smooth. I’ve noticed a reduction in dullness, and my skin looks more radiant and balanced. I highly recommend Vichy 89 for anyone looking to improve their skin’s hydration and overall appearance — it’s definitely become a staple in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Good product particularly with Vichy products.
avis.texte: I use this product regularly with Vichy skin care products. I leaves my skin looking. soft It doesn't absorb as well as the Roche Posay counterpart which I prefer

avis.titre: Sí o sí es muy buena opción
avis.texte: Esta crema me encantó! Muy ligera pero hidratante! Me ayudó mucho en mi embarazo porque tenía la piel un poco más reseca y traté de buscar cremas limpias y naturales para mi piel, lo cual está la amé! Es pequeña pero dura mucho! La recomiendo muchísimo!
Great product. My skin feels great & looks glowy. Reduced acne!

avis.titre: Very good for nomal to oily skin
avis.texte: Great for my mom, but dry skin types will need the "Rich" version instead! I bought the classic Vichy Mineral 89 Fragrance-Free for my mom, and she absolutely loves it—it provides just the right amount of moisture for her skin. However, for my own very dry skin, this formula didn't help at all. If you have genuinely dry skin like me, Vichy makes a "Rich" version of this cream that is fantastic and works much better. This original one is lovely, just make sure you pick the right version for your skin type!
Really like this cream does exactly what is on the jar. Bought few of these now. Great hydration and improved my skin texture.
Diese Creme wird sie nicht enttaüschen. Schon bei der ersten Anwendung wurde meine Haut leuchtend und geglättet. anna
Heerlijk makkelijk uitsmeerbaar en trekt heel snel in. Echt super crème

Esta crema la estoy usando por vez primera , solo llevo aplicándola algunos días, hasta el momento solo puedo decir que es muy ligera, no es grasosa, fresca, siento que me hidrata de una manera increíble la piel del rostro. Aunque el frasco es pequeño con una cantidad mínima es suficiente para toda el área de la cara y cuello que es donde me la aplico. Algo importante a señalar no me brotó la piel como otros productos del mercado. Lo mejor que puedo decir es que no me causó ardor o picazón , muy amigable con mi piel,
It was on sale for Prime day. I will definitely buy it again. I also purchased the Daily Booster serum and they work great together.

This moisturizer works wonders. I love that it's fragrance free. It's a light weight moisturizer that keep my face moisturize all day. I live I southern california where the dry hot days really can dry out my skin, this really keeps it moisturized all day. It comes in a safety sealed box and safety sealed lid with an expiration date.

avis.texte: Cuando me llegó yo noté que la caja la habían abierto y pegado nuevamente con cinta adhesiva, no me importó porque pensé que solo habían roto la caja, después de 4 días de estar usando la crema noté que tenía como aire y metí mi dedo adentro de todo el envase y fue cuando noté que falta la mitad del producto!!!! Ya boté la caja y por eso no hice la devolución. La crema me parece buena, es de buena calidad y siento que me deja la cara hidratada sin sentirla empegostada

This moisturizer is supposed to be 1.69 Oz but half of the bottle is empty. For $32, I expect to receive the full 1.69 oz. The moisturizer is light in texture which I like. It’s not super thick and it glides on your skin nicely. It’s moisturizing and my skin feels hydrated after I apply. Now, I’m not sure about the 72 hour hydration though so I can’t vouch for that.

It is a lightweight moisturizer. The texture is nice and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy or sticky feel. When I apply it to my face in the morning, my skin feels soft, smooth and moisturized. It has no scent. But there is no seal under the lid. Box is not in full of 50 ml.
